title: Nuevo Laredo Doubles Free Shingles Vaccines to 2,000 After Demand Overwhelms First Round

content:
The Government of Nuevo Laredo has doubled its free shingles vaccination campaign from 1,000 to 2,000 doses after the first round of slots ran out, and 500 additional slots are being handed out today.

The expansion was announced Nov. 19 by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal. The city said the available slots for the campaign were exhausted quickly, showing strong demand among residents for preventive health services and for vaccines that are otherwise a significant expense for families.

The increase from 1,000 to 2,000 doses doubles the coverage the city originally planned.

About shingles

Shingles, known in Spanish as herpes zóster or culebrilla, is caused by the reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus, the same virus that causes chickenpox. It can cause a painful skin rash and complications such as persistent nerve pain, mainly in older adults and people whose immune systems are affected.

With the campaign, the municipal government said it is strengthening preventive medicine and reducing the cost barriers that keep residents from high-cost vaccines, prioritizing the well-being and quality of life of the population.

Residents seeking one of the 500 additional slots being distributed today, Friday, Nov. 20, should confirm distribution points and hours with the municipal government.
